svg.title: Selected work: REAMUS, ORBIS, TAD COIN, QB READER, ZEP, CORTIS
svg.desc: REAMUS (reamus.app): An API that turns HTML into PDFs. No browser for you to run. ORBIS (orbis-dev.netlify.app): Discord bots for the parts of a developer workflow that live in chat. TAD COIN (tad-coin.netlify.app): A cryptocurrency named after Terry A. Davis. QB READER (github.com/qbreader/website): A quiz bowl practice site. I work on the web client. ZEP (github.com/wbrous/zep): A general-purpose Discord bot. CORTIS (NOT RELEASED): A messaging app built for developers.
